segments.name: Roblox Platform
segments.description: Operates an immersive gaming and creation platform that lets users explore experiences and creators build, publish, and monetize content.
segments.evidence: Roblox derives revenue globally and manages its business activities on a consolidated basis, resulting in a single operating and reportable segment, which is at the consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Users pay Roblox for Robux used to buy virtual items and experiences, and Roblox retains a portion of every Robux transaction while distributing the rest to creators.
revenueModel.evidence: Roblox retains a portion of every Robux transaction for the Platform and support services we provide to creators and distributes the rest to creators.
